fields.description: When unticked the scheduled job exits immediately and does nothing.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: GCP project id. Used by both the image-sync job above and Teacher Stats Poster below.
fields.label: Project ID

fields.description: Fully qualified messages table used by the image-sync job above, as project.dataset.table.
fields.label: Messages Table

fields.description: Fully qualified media table used by the image-sync job above, as project.dataset.table.
fields.label: Messages Media Table

fields.description: Service account key JSON. Needs BigQuery Data Viewer + Job User on the project above. Stored encrypted. Teacher Stats Poster below reuses this same project_id + credentials_json — it does not keep its own copy.
fields.label: Credentials JSON

fields.description: How far back to query. Keep small — the job runs often and BigQuery bills per byte scanned.
fields.label: Lookback Days

fields.description: How far forward from the last media message to look for the submission. Set from measured drift, not instinct.
fields.label: Match Window (minutes)

fields.description: Maximum submissions processed per run.
fields.label: Batch Limit

fields.description: Timezone of inserted_at in BigQuery. DATETIME carries no timezone, so it must be stated here.
fields.label: Source Timezone

fields.description: SQL LIKE pattern matched against the Glific flow label.
fields.label: Flow Label Filter

fields.description: Counts from the most recent run, for spotting a rising number of unmatched rows.
fields.label: Last Run Summary

fields.description: Fully independent report. Shares ONLY the Project ID / Credentials JSON above (same BigQuery, same service account) — nothing else. Does not read or require the 'Enabled' checkbox, lookback_days, batch_limit, flow_label_filter or any other image-sync field above; has its own tables, filters, secret and schedule. Safe to configure even while the image-sync job above is broken or disabled. This job PUSHES its result to the Apps Script Web App URL below — there is no inbound endpoint to call.
fields.label: Teacher Stats Poster

fields.description: Independent of the 'Enabled' checkbox at the top of this doctype — that one is for the image-sync job only.
fields.label: Enable Teacher Stats Poster

fields.description: The Apps Script Web App URL this job pushes results to, e.g. https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycb.../exec — from Deploy > New deployment > Web app in the spreadsheet's Apps Script editor. Must be deployed with access set to "Anyone" (Apps Script still requires the shared secret below to accept the request).
fields.label: Apps Script Web App URL

fields.description: Shared secret sent as the X-TSP-API-Key header on every push to the Web App above. Must match the value stored in the Apps Script project's Script Properties under TSP_API_KEY exactly. Generate a long random value (32+ chars); never reuse a secret from another integration.
fields.label: Shared Secret

fields.description: BigQuery dataset id (the part between project and table, e.g. the dataset your Glific-to-BigQuery sync writes into). Combined with Project ID above and each table name below to form project.dataset.table — no table name anywhere in this doctype or in code needs the project or dataset repeated.
fields.label: Dataset ID

fields.description: BigQuery CONTACTS table name only (no project or dataset prefix — those come from the fields above). Confirm the exact table name with whoever set up the Glific-to-BigQuery contact sync; it is NOT one of the tables configured above, since nothing above reads contacts. Must have columns: id, phone, updated_at, group_labels, raw_fields (JSON containing school_id.value).
fields.label: Contacts Table

fields.description: BigQuery messages table name for this report, no project or dataset prefix. Both this job and the image-sync job above typically read the same underlying messages table — confirm it has contact_phone, flow_name, flow_label and inserted_at, and set it to match the image-sync job's Messages Table (without the project/dataset prefix) unless your setup genuinely uses a different one for this report.
fields.label: Messages Table (Stats)

fields.description: BigQuery REGEXP_CONTAINS pattern matched against contacts.group_labels, e.g. (^|,)\s*(GROUP_LABEL_ONE|GROUP_LABEL_TWO)\s*(,|$) — replace with your actual Glific group label names.
fields.label: Group Label Regex Pattern

fields.description: SQL LIKE pattern for flow_name, e.g. %YourMainFlowName% — replace with your actual Glific main flow name.
fields.label: Main Flow Name (LIKE pattern)

fields.description: SQL LIKE pattern for flow_label identifying a 'watched' event, e.g. %Activity_Access% — replace with your actual Glific flow label for video-watched.
fields.label: Watched Flow Label (LIKE pattern)

fields.description: SQL LIKE pattern for flow_label identifying a 'shared' event, e.g. %Activity_Submission% — replace with your actual Glific flow label for work-shared.
fields.label: Shared Flow Label (LIKE pattern)

fields.description: Hard cap on bytes BigQuery is allowed to scan for this query, in GB. Passed to BigQuery as maximum_bytes_billed — the query fails rather than run over this, so cost can never silently exceed the cap.
fields.label: Max Query Size (GB)

fields.description: OK, ERROR, or RUNNING while a run is in progress. RUNNING also acts as a lock: a new run started while this is RUNNING, and under 30 minutes old, is skipped rather than started concurrently.
fields.label: Last Run Status

fields.description: Rolling tail of the last 50 runs (OK/ERROR + row counts). For troubleshooting only. No report data is stored here — the sheet, written by Apps Script, is the only place the data itself lives.
fields.label: Run Log
